mechanism: Output-channel balanced digit packing; distinct from scalar block/carry scheduling
paper_argument: For B=2^width and P_i=sum_j w[j,i]*B^j, sum_i a[i]*P_i=sum_j c_j*B^j where c_j=sum_i a[i]*w[j,i] by finite sum distributivity.
With rectangular dimensions k and bounds |a_i|<=ma, |w_ji|<=mw, |c_j|<=k*ma*mw=U. parameters chooses HALF=2^bit_length(U)>U (including U=0 via width>=2).

Offset O=HALF*sum_{j=0}^{tile-1} B^j makes every c_j+HALF in [0,B); hence total+O is nonnegative and has exactly those ordinary base-B digits. Repeated mask and right shift then subtract HALF recovers each signed coefficient without borrow leakage.
The explicit strict-bound negative control [8,-8] at width4 lies outside the proved strict domain and demonstrates carry corruption rather than a valid-input counterexample.
valid_scope: Finite rectangular integer matrix algebra and exact digit representation. This is a paper argument checked against named source, not universal Lean acceptance.
Python cost proxy includes scan/pack/multiply/extract but excludes actual Float32 decode/common exponent/bias/round/exception and is not pinned Lean runtime cost.
integration_obligations: Bind actual raw getters and per-row/per-column integer scale, including metadata and legal dimension/domain guards.
Bias added in same exact sum before one rounding; preserve signed zero fallback and negative bias scale-shift failure.
k=0/empty/rectangular bounds require defined actual caller behavior or exact fallback.
Benchmark actual Lean complete calls against strong public predecessor only as internal bridge to current champion; do not infer Python advantage transfers.
next_discriminator: One small native cost source including real preparation/drop/finish costs before a large formal matrix closure; bind exact source and keep all finite evidence separate.
not_a_second_independent_route: Tiling16 versus tiling64 and D&C packing are variants of this same packing mechanism.
